data.narrative:
Rebel Space is a Seed-stage Defense & Security company founded by Carrie and Gabriel Hernandez that has raised $2.8M to date. The valuation analysis triangulates across a peer set of 3 same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables in Defense & Security, supplemented by a broader universe of 10 public and private defense-tech peers including UFORCE, Anduril Industries, Helsing, Shield AI, and public benchmarks (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS).

Two valuation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis uses the $2.8M raised as a proxy for current valuation and applies a 2.5x step-up multiplier typical of Seed-to-next-stage advancement, implying a $7M valuation. Peer-median analysis across the three comparable companies yields a median valuation of $400M, with observed range of $125M (NODA AI, Series A) to $1.0B (UFORCE, Seed). The wide dispersion reflects heterogeneity in stage and market positioning within the Defense & Security frontier-tech segment.

Triangulation produces a median implied valuation of $204M, with a reasonable range from $6M (conservative stage-based) to $460M (peer-driven ceiling). The wide spread reflects genuine uncertainty: stage-progression suggests early-stage pricing discipline, while peer comparables span nearly two orders of magnitude. Key uncertainties include customer traction, technical differentiation relative to the named peer set, and the degree to which comparable companies' valuations reflect sector momentum versus company-specific fundamentals.
